title: The detail score improved. The picture still looked much the same.
summary: DVD07 lowered measured fine-detail error by 14.40% across nine validation regions, including 15.52% on one action-and-effects frame. Reviewers saw no clear visible gain, and the structural result missed its 5% target, so the candidate was not promoted.
problem: The project is trying to recover useful image detail without changing the larger drawing. In this round, the fine-detail measure moved, but the structural gain was too small to pass the agreed review gate.
response: DVD05 remains the strongest candidate. The next step is to find new, well-matched scenes before considering another limited experiment.
beforeDetail: DVD05 entered the review as the strongest candidate. In the same EP007 action-and-effects crop, fine-detail error was 0.0008194. The enlarged frame already looked close to the comparison target.
afterDetail: DVD07 lowered the score to 0.0006923, a 15.52% change. The enlarged review still showed no clear visible gain; the masked structure result improved just 0.82%, below the 5% gate.
imageNote: The comparison below uses the same reviewed EP007 action-and-effects frame for DVD05 and the rejected DVD07 candidate. Reviewers saw no clear visible gain.
stageTitle: Find new scenes that can answer a better question.
stageNote: DVD07 was not promoted. New scene selection is the next step.
nextStep: Find well-matched narrative scenes in EP001–EP006, keeping EP007 reserved for validation.
metricNote: DVD05 measurements across 24 regions; the eight validation regions had already been consulted during development. These are error changes, not visual improvement scores.
